- fit a model on a dataset with one response and 3 features.

- pick up a single feature as a reference

- select a test observation and compute the shapley value for your feature of choice.

- repeat the process for each feature in the dataset.

- plot the shapley values for each feature.

- try to implement the Štrumbelj and Kononenko (2014) approximation to the shapley values computation,
check the differences.
